description: Fetch citations, references, or the citation count for a scholarly DOI from the OpenCitations index.

doi.description: The DOI to look up. Accepts a bare DOI (e.g. "10.1186/1756-8722-6-59"), a "doi:" prefix, or a full "https://doi.org/…" URL.
doi.title: DOI

maxItems.description: Maximum number of citation/reference records to return (ignored for citation count, which is always a single record).
maxItems.title: Max Items

mode.description: What to fetch for the given DOI: incoming citations, outgoing references, or the total citation count.
enumTitles: Get citation count (how many cite this DOI)
mode.title: Mode

title: OpenCitations Scraper Input
